"""One corrective control with the known idle competing consumer quiesced."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

assert os.geteuid() == 0 and os.uname().nodename == 'anvil-qa-v1'
base = Path('/var/lib/anvil-qa-v1/runtime-functional')
bridge = base / 'native-control-bridge'
folder = base / 'transport-exclusive-e49e149-v1'
identifier = '859ec87154c9c33a40bb21104804d83895dacd6f0e839a769f6d455c0d6cc22f'
old_image = 'us-west1-docker.pkg.dev/adi-anvil-mvp-2026/anvil-qa-v1/kyc-runtime@sha256:3640267a76ea1960df045a0cb354322473a27b92641b2e4b1d2b409b85771386'
baseline_pins = {
    Path('/var/lib/anvil-qa-v1/config/compose-app.json'): '48ca71dac9acea4e3650452474d4c6ce23a8eece847be556b50c274dd68ec5bc',
    base / 'harbor-proof/component-qualification/current.json': '634fc636eb4df0c5fe265457a006f42ab7900b71ad739907ac38b808b48e41a1',
    base / 'capture-database-qualification/current.json': 'dcad1e15003676eac58cacef48f56624990b05e791de2bf21d877632b5afdfa7',
}
manifest = Path('/tmp/forge-release-e49e149/release.json')
assert hashlib.sha256(manifest.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == '2825d469a78a8126e14bc71d6d592c49abb73f2c117088e8a80bc358a1936404'
release = json.loads(manifest.read_bytes())
assert release['revision'] == 'e49e149d814d43b8028d11cfe95e7398acbf8318'
assert release['source_sha256'] == 'c26a7965e3ee215aa74e495c5341c15a2e0423f3952a1799111e8eef688201e4'
operator = base / 'controls-e49e149/runtime-checks/native_transport_operator.py'
assert operator.resolve() == operator and operator.stat().st_uid == 0 and not operator.stat().st_mode & 0o022
assert hashlib.sha256(operator.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == release['control_files']['runtime-checks/native_transport_operator.py']

def inspect(value):
    return json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['docker', 'inspect', value], timeout=15))[0]

def owned():
    info = inspect(identifier)
    assert info['Id'] == identifier and info['Name'] == '/anvil-qa-v1-native-coordinator-1'
    assert info['Config']['Image'] == old_image
    assert info['Config']['Labels']['com.docker.compose.project'] == 'anvil-qa-v1'
    assert info['Config']['Labels']['com.docker.compose.service'] == 'native-coordinator'
    assert info['Config']['Labels']['org.opencontainers.image.revision'] == '88214ba7b67dafe097dc297825611beb85df9637'
    return info

def quiescent():
    for path in bridge.iterdir():
        if path.is_dir() and any((path / n).exists() for n in ('request.json', 'claimed.json')):
            assert any((path / n).exists() for n in ('completion.json', 'failed.json', 'result.json')), 'Unresolved bridge attempt'
    command = 'exec psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -X -A -t -c "SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM banking.commands),(SELECT count(*) FROM banking.execution_jobs)"'
    assert subprocess.check_output(['docker', 'exec', 'anvil-qa-v1-postgres-1', 'sh', '-c', command], timeout=15).decode().strip() == '0|0'

def consumers():
    values = subprocess.check_output(['docker', 'ps', '-q'], timeout=15).decode().split()
    found = []
    for value in values:
        info = inspect(value)
        pairs = [item.split('=', 1) for item in info['Config']['Env']]
        assert len(pairs) == len({item[0] for item in pairs})
        environment = dict(pairs)
        if environment.get('ANVIL_NATIVE_BRIDGE_ROOT') == str(bridge) and environment.get('ANVIL_GOLDEN_NATIVE_COORDINATOR_ENABLED') == 'true':
            found.append(info['Id'])
    return found

def baseline():
    assert all(hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == pin for path, pin in baseline_pins.items())

def profile(info):
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps({'host': info['HostConfig'], 'user': info['Config']['User'],
        'entrypoint': info['Config']['Entrypoint'], 'cmd': info['Config']['Cmd'], 'env': info['Config']['Env'],
        'mounts': info['Mounts']}, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()

def controls():
    return set(subprocess.check_output(['docker', 'ps', '-aq', '--filter', 'label=io.adi.forge.scope=native-transport-control'], timeout=15).decode().split())

baseline()
original = owned()
assert original['State']['Running']
original_profile = profile(original)
before_controls = controls()
quiescent()
assert consumers() == [identifier], 'Reconcile other bridge consumers first'
folder.mkdir(mode=0o700)
parent_fd = os.open(folder.parent, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY)
try:
    os.fsync(parent_fd)
finally:
    os.close(parent_fd)

def save(name, body):
    raw = body if isinstance(body, bytes) else json.dumps(body, sort_keys=True).encode()
    with os.fdopen(os.open(folder / name, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600), 'wb') as out:
        out.write(raw)
        out.flush()
        os.fsync(out.fileno())
    fd = os.open(folder, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)

save('intent.json', {'old_id': identifier, 'old_image': old_image, 'manifest_sha256': hashlib.sha256(manifest.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'purpose': 'one_fresh_transport_control', 'prior_attempt_replayed': False, 'serving_config_changed': False, 'model_calls_authorized': 0,
    'original_profile_sha256': original_profile, 'originally_running': True, 'before_control_ids': sorted(before_controls)})
result = None
retention_failures = []
try:
    baseline()
    quiescent()
    assert profile(owned()) == original_profile and consumers() == [identifier]
    subprocess.run(['docker', 'stop', '--time', '10', identifier], capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=30)
    info = owned()
    assert not info['State']['Running'] and not info['State']['Restarting'] and info['State']['Pid'] == 0
    quiescent()
    assert consumers() == []
    result = subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3', str(operator), '--manifest', str(manifest), '--observe-network'],
        capture_output=True, timeout=1000)
    save('control.stdout', result.stdout)
    save('control.private.stderr', result.stderr)
finally:
    restored = {'id': identifier, 'running': False, 'qualification_granted': False}
    child_cleanup = []
    try:
        created = controls() - before_controls
        for value in sorted(created):
            try:
                info = inspect(value)
                assert info['Config']['Image'] == release['images']['kyc-runtime']
                assert info['Config']['Labels'].get('io.adi.forge.scope') == 'native-transport-control'
                assert info['Name'].startswith(('/forge-transport-worker-e49e149d814d-', '/forge-transport-sdk-e49e149d814d-'))
                was_running = info['State']['Running']
                if was_running:
                    subprocess.run(['docker', 'stop', '--time', '1', info['Id']], capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=6)
                terminal = inspect(info['Id'])
                assert not terminal['State']['Running'] and not terminal['State']['Restarting'] and terminal['State']['Pid'] == 0
                child_cleanup.append({'id': info['Id'], 'terminal': True, 'required_stop': was_running, 'exit_code': terminal['State']['ExitCode']})
            except BaseException as error:
                child_cleanup.append({'id': value, 'unknown_retained': True, 'error_type': type(error).__name__})
    except BaseException as error:
        child_cleanup.append({'unknown_retained': True, 'error_type': type(error).__name__})
    try:
        save('child-cleanup.json', child_cleanup)
    except BaseException as error:
        retention_failures.append({'phase': 'retain-child-cleanup', 'error_type': type(error).__name__})
    try:
        # Only successful original operator completion proves its retained
        # observer PIDFDs terminated. Timeout/nonzero is an explicit HOLD.
        assert result is not None and result.returncode == 0, 'Observer lifetime requires reconciliation'
        assert not any(item.get('unknown_retained') for item in child_cleanup)
        baseline()
        quiescent()
        assert consumers() == [], 'A competing consumer remains active'
        info = owned()
        assert not info['State']['Running'] and info['State']['Pid'] == 0
        subprocess.run(['docker', 'start', identifier], capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=30)
        info = owned()
        assert info['State']['Running'] and info['State']['Pid'] > 0
        assert profile(info) == original_profile
        restored['running'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        restored['unknown_retained'] = True
        restored['error_type'] = type(error).__name__
        try:
            actual = owned()
            restored['observed_running'] = actual['State']['Running']
            restored['observed_pid'] = actual['State']['Pid']
        except BaseException:
            restored['observed_state_unknown'] = True
    try:
        save('restore.json', restored)
    except BaseException as error:
        retention_failures.append({'phase': 'retain-restoration', 'error_type': type(error).__name__})
    if retention_failures:
        print(json.dumps({'retention_failures': retention_failures, 'restoration': restored}), flush=True)
assert restored['running'] and not restored.get('unknown_retained'), 'Coordinator restoration requires reconciliation'
assert not retention_failures, 'Evidence retention incomplete; no qualification'
assert len(child_cleanup) == 2 and all(item.get('terminal') and not item.get('required_stop') and item.get('exit_code') == 0 for item in child_cleanup)
assert result is not None and result.returncode == 0, 'Corrective transport did not pass; no further retry'
print(result.stdout.decode(), end='')
print(json.dumps({'known_old_coordinator_restored': identifier, 'serving_configuration_changed': False, 'qualification_granted': False}))
